description.p: Clara is a type family created specially by Séamas Ó Brógáin for printing A Dictionary of Editing (2015). The family includes italic, bold, bold italic, and small capitals, while the character set includes (monotonic) Greek, Cyrillic, ogham, phonetic and mathematical ranges, scribal abbreviations and other specialist characters. The fonts also include some OpenType features (such as ligature substitution, small capitals, and old-style numerals) and variant forms for particular languages.
